name: Harborage
summary: At the northern edge of the Swamp of Sorrows, Harborage shelters exiled Draenor natives who have kept their minds. They seek peace by the water in a harsh wilderness.

sections.title: A Haven in the Mire
sections.body: At the foot of the northern mountains, you find Harborage, a small camp apart from the feral tribes in the nearby waters. Leather shelters and hanging crystals mark this refuge for exiled survivors from Draenor who have kept their minds. Elders like Magtoor guide the community. Together, they watch the wilderness, its native predators, and the feral tribes of their fallen brothers beyond the camp.

faq.answer: Draenor exiles live in Harborage. Though afflicted and changed after crossing into Azeroth, they have kept their minds and culture, unlike the feral tribes elsewhere in the swamp.

faq.q: Why are the people here peaceful while other swamp tribes attack?
faq.answer: Harborage's residents kept their sanity and reason despite their physical transformation and displacement. Their kin across the bog lost their minds to isolation and trauma. Here, the exiles joined together to preserve their dignity.
Respected elders like Magtoor guide the community as it survives in an alien swamp.
Harborage lies against the northern cliffs of the Swamp of Sorrows, just east of the mountain pass to the Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler leaving Redridge for the dangerous marsh, Harborage is one of the few places in the northern swamp where you can meet people without facing immediate bloodshed.
Stonard holds much of the Horde's presence in the swamp. Harborage's reclusive survivors keep to themselves rather than take sides in the regional conflicts.
